ClassFeatures.PrimalKnowledgeManual: Choose one additional Barbarian skill proficiency at level 3. While Rage is active, the sheet uses Strength for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks; the proficiency choice still needs to be recorded manually.
ClassFeatures.PrimalOrderManual: The chosen order, extra cantrip, Warden proficiencies, and Magician Arcana/Nature bonus are tracked by the character sheet. Other Magician spellcasting choices remain in the normal spellcasting flow.
ClassFeatures.WarlockInvocationManual: The selected level-1 invocation is recorded on the character. Its game effect still needs to be applied manually.
ClassFeatures.BardicInspirationManual: Tracked uses recover on a Long Rest, or on a Short Rest from Bard level 5. Choose an eligible ally within 60 feet who can see or hear you, then resolve the die manually: d6 at Bard 1–4, d8 at 5–9, d10 at 10–14, and d12 at 15+.
ClassFeatures.BardExpertiseManual: When importing a Bard, verify that past Expertise choices are reflected on the character's skills.
ClassFeatures.BardCountercharmManual: Manual Reaction: when you or a creature within 30 feet fails a save against an effect that would give it Charmed or Frightened, make it reroll with Advantage.
ClassFeatures.BardSuperiorInspirationManual: Initiative rolls from the character sheet restore Bardic Inspiration to two uses when below two. If you roll Initiative elsewhere, restore uses manually.
ClassFeatures.SuperiorInspirationRecovered: Superior Inspiration restored Bardic Inspiration to two uses.
ClassFeatures.SuperiorInspirationUnavailable: Initiative was rolled, but Superior Inspiration could not update Bardic Inspiration. Restore it manually if needed.
ClassFeatures.BardWordsOfCreationManual: Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill are always prepared, and either can target a second creature within 10 feet of the first. Power Word Heal is missing from this ruleset's spell pack; track it manually until added. The extra target is also resolved manually.
ClassFeatures.ArcaneRecoveryHow: Choose spell slots to recover when you finish a Short Rest. Available once per Long Rest.
ClassFeatures.MemorizeSpellHow: Choose one prepared level 1+ Wizard spell and replace it with another level 1+ spell from your spellbook.
ClassFeatures.MemorizeSpellInvalid: Choose one prepared Wizard spell and a different eligible spell from your spellbook.
ClassFeatures.SpellMasteryReplacePrompt: You may replace one Spell Mastery spell with a same-level action spell from your spellbook. Leave blank to keep your choices.
ClassFeatures.SpellMasteryReplaceInvalid: Choose a selected Spell Mastery spell and a different same-level action spell from your Wizard spellbook.
ClassFeatures.MemorizeSpellHowCard: After a Long Rest, you can replace one prepared level 1+ spell with another from your spellbook.
ClassFeatures.ArcaneRecoveryBudget: Recover spell slots with a combined level up to {budget}.
ClassFeatures.ArcaneRecoveryUnavailable: Arcane Recovery is unavailable or already used since your last Long Rest.
ClassFeatures.ArcaneRecoveryNoSlots: There are no expended eligible spell slots to recover.
ClassFeatures.ArcaneRecoveryInvalid: Choose at least one expended slot within the recovery limit.
ClassFeatures.RageRecovery: 1 on short rest / all on long rest
ClassFeatures.RageManualEffects: Use count, resistance, qualifying damage bonus, spell blocking, Strength advantage, Concentration and combat duration are tracked. Outside the combat tracker, manage duration manually; other damage cases remain manual.
ClassFeatures.IndomitableMightUsed: Indomitable Might replaces the original total {original} with your Strength score {score}.
ClassFeatures.IndomitableMightUnavailable: Indomitable Might is unavailable or this result cannot be replaced.
ClassFeatures.RageResistedDamage: Rage resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage is halved.
ClassFeatures.RageManualDuration: Rage is active. Without the combat tracker, manage its duration manually or end it from the sheet.
ClassFeatures.RageTurnTracked: Duration follows the combat tracker. On your next turn, use Maintain Rage after an attack against an enemy, a forced save, or a Bonus Action.
ClassFeatures.RageExtensionPrompt: After making an attack against an enemy, forcing a save, or taking your Bonus Action this turn, confirm to maintain Rage for another round.
ClassFeatures.RagePersistentTracked: Persistent Rage: the tracker handles its 10-minute limit; no per-turn extension is needed.
ClassFeatures.RageExtended: Rage maintained until the end of your next turn.
ClassFeatures.RageExtensionUnavailable: You can only confirm an extension on your eligible turn with the combat tracker active.
ClassFeatures.RageCannotActivateHeavyArmor: Rage cannot be activated while wearing Heavy armor.
ClassFeatures.RageCannotCastSpells: You cannot cast spells while Raging.
ClassFeatures.MonkFocusSpendManually: Focus Points are tracked and return on a Short or Long Rest. Spend one when you use a feature that requires it; resolve the feature effect manually.
ClassFeatures.UncannyMetabolismManual: You can choose this when you roll Initiative: restore all Focus Points, then regain HP equal to Monk level plus your Martial Arts die roll. This sheet tracks the once-per-Long-Rest use; restore Focus and roll/apply HP manually.
ClassFeatures.MonkFeatureManual: This feature is recorded from the SRD 5.2 class table. Resolve its trigger and effect manually; this ruleset does not automate it yet.

LevelUp.ProgressionActorChanged: This character changed after the wizard opened. Reopen Level Up and review the new values before saving.
LevelUp.MulticlassRecoveryResumeHint: Resume the saved sequence. Confirmed steps will not be repeated.
LevelUp.MulticlassRecoveryReview: A previous write has an uncertain result or an unreadable checkpoint. Review the actor and item records before proceeding; automatic retry is disabled.
LevelUp.MulticlassRecoveryResumeFirst: Resume or review the pending progression before starting another one.
LevelUp.EpicBoonChoiceHint: choose an eligible Epic Boon feat.
LevelUp.AbilityChoiceHint: increase one score by 2, or two scores by 1 each (max 20) — or take an eligible feat instead.
LevelUp.ChooseSubclassRequired: Choose the subclass required at this class level before saving.
LevelUp.CompleteAbilityChoice: Complete the required ability or feat choice before saving.
LevelUp.WizardScholarHelp: Choose one proficient skill: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion. You gain Expertise in it.
LevelUp.ChooseWizardScholarSkill: Choose one listed skill in which you are proficient.
LevelUp.SpellMasteryHelp: Choose one level 1 and one level 2 action spell from your Wizard spellbook. Both stay prepared.
LevelUp.ChooseSpellMasterySpells: Choose one eligible spell of each level.
LevelUp.SignatureSpellsHelp: Choose two different level 3 spells from your Wizard spellbook. Each can be cast once per Short or Long Rest without a slot.
LevelUp.ChooseSignatureSpells: Choose two different eligible level 3 spells.
LevelUp.RogueExpertiseHelp: Choose two proficient skills without Expertise.
LevelUp.RogueLanguageHelp: You know Thieves' Cant and one other language.
LevelUp.ChooseRogueLanguage: Choose one language you do not already know.
LevelUp.BardExpertiseHelp: Choose two proficient skills without Expertise. You gain Expertise in both.
LevelUp.ChooseBardExpertiseSkills: Choose exactly two proficient skills that do not already have Expertise.
LevelUp.WeaponMasteryHelp: Select the required number of weapons to record their mastery properties.
LevelUp.ChooseWeaponMastery: Complete the listed Weapon Mastery choices.
LevelUp.WeaponMasteryRestHelp: After a Long Rest, each class may replace one selected weapon. Leave both fields blank to keep that class's choices.
LevelUp.WeaponMasteryInvalid: Weapon Mastery choices were not changed because a selection was invalid.
LevelUp.FightingStyleManualNotice: Choose one available SRD Fighting Style feat. Its effect is recorded with its rules text; apply it manually for now. Dueling and Protection are listed by the class feature but are missing from this ruleset's feat pack.
LevelUp.DivineOrderProtector: Protector — gain Martial weapon proficiency and Heavy armor training.
LevelUp.DivineOrderThaumaturge: Thaumaturge — choose one extra Cleric cantrip; add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks.
LevelUp.ChooseDivineOrder: Choose Protector or Thaumaturge. Thaumaturge also requires a distinct Cleric cantrip.
LevelUp.PrimalOrderMagician: Magician — learn one extra Druid cantrip; add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) checks.
LevelUp.PrimalOrderWarden: Warden — gain Martial weapon proficiency and Medium armor training.
LevelUp.ChoosePrimalOrder: Choose Magician or Warden. Magician also requires a distinct Druid cantrip.
LevelUp.WarlockInvocationHelp: Choose one level-1 invocation without a prerequisite. Its effect is recorded for manual use.
LevelUp.ChooseWarlockInvocation: Choose one available invocation to continue.
LevelUp.ChooseMulticlassProficiencies: Complete the required proficiency choices to continue.
LevelUp.CompleteSpellChoices: Choose the required new class spells and cantrips before saving.
LevelUp.WizardSpellbookChoiceHint: Add exactly two new eligible spells to the spellbook:
LevelUp.WizardSpellbookReview: This Wizard's spellbook or prepared list cannot be reconciled with its recorded class level. Review the spell items before advancing.
LevelUp.BardSpellbookReview: Existing Bard spells do not have verified class provenance and table-consistent counts. Review or migrate these items before leveling up.
LevelUp.SorcererSpellbookReview: Existing Sorcerer spells do not have verified class provenance and table-consistent counts. Review or migrate these items before leveling up.
LevelUp.SorcererReplacementRules: Each Sorcerer level lets you replace one prepared Sorcerer spell and one Sorcerer cantrip. Choose both replacements; new table-granted spells are selected separately.
LevelUp.WarlockSpellbookReview: Existing Warlock spells do not have verified class provenance and table-consistent counts. Review or migrate these items before leveling up.
LevelUp.WarlockReplacementRules: Each Warlock level lets you replace one prepared Warlock spell and one Warlock cantrip. Choose both replacements; new table-granted spells are selected separately.
LevelUp.MysticArcanumNew: Choose the Warlock spell granted as Mystic Arcanum, circle
LevelUp.MysticArcanumReplace: You may optionally replace one existing Mystic Arcanum spell this Warlock level.
LevelUp.MysticArcanumReview: Review the Arcanum choice and same-circle replacement before leveling up.
LevelUp.BardReplacementRules: Each Bard level lets you replace one prepared Bard spell and one Bard cantrip. Choose both replacements; new table-granted spells are selected separately.
LevelUp.WizardSpellbookOnly: Prepare levelled Wizard spells from the spellbook.
LevelUp.DistinctAbilityChoices: Choose two different abilities, or leave the second choice blank for +2 to one ability.
LevelUp.AbilityScoreCap: This increase would raise an ability score above 20.
LevelUp.CharacterLevelCap: A character cannot advance beyond level 20.
LevelUp.PactMigrationReview: Review the legacy Pact Magic pool before advancing this character.
LevelUp.ProgressionRefreshFailed: Could not refresh this character. No progression changes were applied.
LevelUp.SubclassSpellGrantUnavailable: A required subclass spell is unavailable in the class spell list. No class level was applied.
LevelUp.ProgressionCommitFailed: Level Up stopped after an operation failed. Some choices may already be saved; reopen and review before retrying.
LevelUp.FeatManualInstruction: This feat's benefits and extra choices are listed as text and still need manual application.
LevelUp.FeatAbilityIncrease: This structured feat increases ability scores; choose one score for +2 or two different scores for +1 each.
LevelUp.CompleteFeatAbilityChoice: Choose valid ability scores for this feat before saving.
LevelUp.SkilledChoiceHint: Skilled grants three different skill or tool proficiencies.
LevelUp.CompleteFeatChoices: Complete all distinct proficiency choices granted by this feat before saving.
LevelUp.FeatChoiceAlreadyOwned: This feat cannot grant a proficiency the character already has.
LevelUp.FeatEligibilityNotice: Feats with prerequisites the ruleset cannot verify stay unavailable until structured rule data is added.

Steps.IdentityIntro: Every legend starts with a name. How will the bards sing your glories?
Steps.BioPlaceholder: Where did you come from? What event brought you to adventure?
Steps.RaceIntro: Ancestry defines your basic instincts, attribute bonuses and innate abilities.
Steps.ClassIntro: Class defines your combat abilities, feats and spell progression.
Steps.AbilitiesIntro: Distribute your points to define your hero's physical and mental capabilities.
Steps.SkillsIntro: Choose the skills your character is trained in (Proficient) according to your Vocation.
Steps.SpellsIntro: As a caster, you must choose your starting spells.
Steps.NoSpells: No spells available for your class at level 1.
Steps.LanguagesIntro: Based on your Intelligence and ancestry, you can choose additional languages. You selected {count} of {max} available.
Steps.LanguagesHint: Additional languages represent your character's erudition and ability to communicate across different cultures.
Steps.ReviewIntro: Review your chronicle before awakening your hero to the world.
Steps.FinalWarning: “Once the journey begins, fate is drawn.”
Steps.FinalHint: Ensure all details are correct. By proceeding, the hero will awaken.
